target_customer: Fortune 500 scale B2C enterprises in retail, banking, insurance, telecom, healthcare, travel and logistics
problem: Large companies run costly support and sales contact centers on legacy IT systems, and existing bots do not take revenue-driving actions inside those systems.
business_model: enterprise B2B software for voice and chat agents and agent copilot (pricing not found)
product_category: AI customer support and sales agents for enterprises

founders.name: Nalin Gupta
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a 2x YC founder (S15 and P26).

competitors.name: Sierra, Decagon, Cresta, Parloa, Ada
competitors.funding_then: heavily funded per a YC profile article

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and chat agents that act inside legacy enterprise systems require integrations and reliability, though foundation models do the language work.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration with enterprise systems can lock in customers, but well funded rivals sell the same product.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found as of 2026; the category stayed crowded.

market_need_then: Enterprises spent heavily on support operations and were adopting AI agents in 2025; funding in the category was large in late 2025.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch listed (June 2026 per a directory).

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found; name search returns Cigna and Cigno instead.

outcome_analysis: Cignara is a Spring 2026 YC company whose repeat founder previously sold a self-driving startup. It claims LG as a customer (company marketing only) in a category with much better funded rivals. It is too early for an outcome, so the main question is whether enterprise sales traction outpaces Sierra, Decagon and PolyAI.
notes: Funding: one aggregator (FundedIQ) lists $500k pre-seed June 2026; single source, unverified, not recorded as a round. The LG customer claim is company marketing only. Cigno (a different company) appears in funding results and was excluded. Founded year 2025 per YC page. Success factor founder_market_fit is weak: the founder's prior work was self-driving, not support.
